message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build
on: [push, pull_request]
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  macos-metal:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with: 
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: .ci/mac-metal.sh
  macos-gl:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with: 
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: .ci/mac-gl.sh
  ios:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with: 
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: .ci/ios.sh
  linux-gl:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with: 
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: sudo -E apt-add-repository -y "ppa:ubuntu-toolchain-r"
      - run: sudo apt-get install libglew-dev
      - run: .ci/linux-gl.sh
  windows-direct3d11:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with: 
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: |
          cd examples
          ..\\pmbuild win32 -libs
          ..\\pmbuild win32
          ..\\pmbuild make win32 all /p:Platform=x64 /p:Configuration=Release
  windows-opengl:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with: 
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: |
          cd examples
          ..\\pmbuild win32-gl -libs
          ..\\pmbuild win32-gl
          ..\\pmbuild make win32-gl all /p:Platform=x64 /p:Configuration=Release
  macos-editor:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with: 
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: |
          cd tools
          ../pmbuild mac-editor -libs
          ../pmbuild mac-editor
          ../pmbuild make mac-editor all
  windows-editor:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with: 
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: |
          cd tools
          ..\\pmbuild win32-editor -libs
          ..\\pmbuild win32-editor
          ..\\pmbuild make win32-editor pmtech_editor /p:Platform=x64 /p:Configuration=Release
          ..\\pmbuild make win32-editor all /p:Platform=x64 /p:Configuration=Release
  linux-editor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - run: |
          sudo -E apt-add-repository -y "ppa:ubuntu-toolchain-r"
          sudo apt-get install libglew-dev
          cd tools
          ../pmbuild linux-editor -libs
          ../pmbuild linux-editor
          ../pmbuild make linux-editor all
  android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          submodules: "recursive"
          lfs: true
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: "temurin"
          java-version: "21"
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.14.3
      - run: |
          cd examples
          ../pmbuild android
          cd build/android
          gradle wrapper
          ./gradlew assembleRelease",
  "rationale": "Add concurrency with cancel-in-progress to cancel superseded runs for the same branch/PR. This optimization is supported by pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE, which estimates VM time reduction (free: 1.9%, paid: 4.1%) and is safe for build workflows without deployment steps. The workflow triggers on push and pull_request, meeting the precondition that runs represent the same workflow and branch/PR, and a newer revision supersedes older checks.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
